Looking at the data patterns:

## Example 1 (2025-08-26)
- History is around 71-73 range, showing some volatility
- Model forecasts are generally lower than true outcomes
- The divergence appears to increase further out - model underestimates significantly by day 20+

Looking at the first 10 days comparison:
- Day 1: Model 72.68 vs True 72.75 (off by +0.07)
- Day 5: Model 73.40 vs True 73.97 (off by +0.57)
- Day 10: Model 75.26 vs True 77.17 (off by +1.91)
- Day 20: Model 72.81 vs True 76.21 (off by +3.40)
- Day 25: Model 72.77 vs True 75.72 (off by +2.95)
- Day 30: Model 76.20 vs True 78.75 (off by +2.55)

The model is consistently UNDERFORECASTING, and the error grows with horizon.

## Example 2 (2025-08-25)
Similar pattern - model forecasts are generally 1-4 points too low compared to true outcomes.

Looking at the first 10 days:
- Day 1: Model 71.95 vs True 72.19 (+0.24)
- Day 5: Model 72.22 vs True 72.99 (+0.77)
- Day 10: Model 73.95 vs True 76.04 (+2.09)
- Day 20: Model 74.89 vs True 77.55 (+2.66)
- Day 25: Model 70.42 vs True 75.72 (+5.30)
- Day 30: Model 70.85 vs True 79.16 (+8.31)


The divergence intensifies, with later days showing increasingly significant underestimation. Model predictions remain consistently below actual outcomes, with differences expanding from minor 0.2-point variations to substantial 8-point discrepancies.
